blurb: Safe Harbor provides marina facilities with secure berths for yachts and offers member-exclusive experiences such as sailing regattas, culinary events, and VIP excursions at various locations including West Palm Beach, Montauk, Newport, San Diego, and Fort Lauderdale. Members can enjoy waterside breakfasts, spectator cruises, live entertainment, and curated excursions. The experiences are seasonal and include social and recreational activities on and off the water.
extraNote: Use of services is at your own risk · Must be at least 18 years old or legal adult to use services
